system.description: Wrathful warrior-king and unifier, protector of his people and god of stable civilization; the most widely worshipped god among humans, with many squat followers.
system.summary: Wrathful warrior-king and unifier, protector of his people and god of stable civilization; the most widely worshipped god among humans, with many squat followers.
commandments: Cooperate with others; organized communities beat lone efforts.
Tame the wild for settlement and guard civilization from the dark.
Pursue new ideas, lands and inventions; build machines, cities and empires.
directives: Spread civilization until the whole Wheel is linked.
Bring nature to heel and turn Chaos into Order.
His will needs many hands; join something larger than yourself.
Government embodies his will and must meet his standards to keep his blessing.
Raise armies and protect civilization from those who would ruin it.

cults.name: The Inquisition
cults.summary: A relentless, well-funded organization with divine authority to wipe out Chaos worship, rumoured to have agents everywhere.

cults.name: The City Watch
cults.summary: Civic cults in most major cities that organize public works, report threats and keep communities safe and united.
